newAddress.description: The address in the new build, or null when it could not be mapped.

confidence.description: 0-1: the function match's trust times how exactly the instruction aligned.

reason.description: function_start, aligned_instruction, replaced_instruction, same_string, followed_references; or why not: function_not_matched, ambiguous, instruction_removed, changed_region, conflicting_references, no_reference_to_follow, not_an_instruction.

candidates.description: Candidate or nearby new addresses when not mapped.
